title: Lack of bands for young players and difficulty of new ideas
summary: Few bands exist for students to learn section playing, and it is hard to avoid copying your own style.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Plus the opportunities to sit in a big band and absorb all that information over the years is not there like it was unless you’re in an educational school —

Yep that’s right. I really bemoan the fact that there aren’t any bands for these kids to go out and get real training. I mean there’s nothing like being in a band, whether it be a small band or a big band, but big band, learning how to play in a section, how to balance, you know, how to listen. It’s really important.
As time goes by and terrific arrangers come and go, does it become harder to create something new?
